name: Acrylic Bookmark
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Best Material: All bookmarks are hand-made. We hand-select each piece of acrylic for its unique grain, knots, and natural imperfections which add character. Every bookmark is hand cut, sanded and stained. Bookmarks will not peel, bubble or separate from the wood like vinyl decals or paper overlays often do.

 

  • Perfect Quality and Durability: Design is printed directly to the acrylic. It is totally BOTH-SIDE printed in modern technology and is covered by superior copperplate paper painting, durable and vivid color. These bookmarks are made with the highest quality materials and the utmost attention to detail, making them gifts to be treasured for many years to come.

 

  • Easy to Customize:Each bookmark is made to order and may vary slightly from our sample photo. We are more than happy to customize and personalize them any way you’d like! You can expect some variance in color, and texture. This is what make yours a one-of-a-kind.

 

  • Widely Usage: Bookmarks are ideal decorations choice when you want to hold themed parties or family gathering, to decorate your home, garden, office, yard and other places, let your guests more happier, and have a good time together. Also, bookmarks can be applied for card making, hanging accessories, embellishments, scrapbooking, sign making, home decoration and so on.

 

  • Gift of love: A perfect idea if you are finding a birthday gift, a housewarming gift, a festival gift, a Mother’s Day/ Father’s Day/ Christmas gift for your family or friends. These make a nice sentimental and personalized gift for you, your loved one, a book club, or even stocking stuffers!

 

  • Easy to use: Comes with a pre-punched hole for attaching accessories or ribbons. 0,12 inches thick – perfect thickness to not crease your pages or bend the spine as other acrylic bookmarks do. It can be wiped with a towel containing wax or grease.

 

SPECIFICATION

 

  • Processing Time: 3 – 5 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly

 

  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)

 

  • Packaging: 1x Acrylic bookmark

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 

 

  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

 

  • Download templates and mockups here
  • Printing File and Mockup Generator Guideline Video

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
